title: Torn newspaper clipping on John Glenn's 'fireflies' and unknown luminous particles
description: Yellowed, irregularly torn newspaper clipping with a partial headline beginning "President" and a column reporting that astronaut Glenn turned his spacecraft to check "whether the mysterious 'fireflies' he had noticed on his first orbit might be paint or other particles from his craft," and that "Scientists here believe the still unknown luminous particles" may be important. A red pencil line marks the margin beside these paragraphs. Adjacent are fragments of a story headlined "No Need ... For Anti..." on strontium levels in milk, a "CORRECTION" notice and a grocery ad for "FRYERS or BROILERS."
